mapper.select: SELECT * FROM amenities ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT a.* FROM amenities a JOIN ${type}_amenities ta ON ta.amenity_id = a.id -- 필요시 group by 또는 distinct
SELECT * FROM amenity_translations WHERE amenity_id = #{amenityId} ORDER BY id ASC
SELECT t.* FROM amenities a JOIN ${type}_amenities ta ON ta.amenity_id = a.id JOIN amenity_translations t ON t.amenity_id = a.id WHERE t.language_code = #{languageCode}

SELECT t.*, a.code FROM amenity_destination_types adt JOIN amenities a ON a.id = adt.amenity_id JOIN amenity_translations t ON t.amenity_id = a.id WHERE adt.destination_type = #{destinationType} AND t.language_code = #{languageCode} ORDER BY t.id
SELECT amenity_id, destination_type FROM amenity_destination_types ORDER BY amenity_id, destination_type
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO amenity_translations (amenity_id, language_code, name) VALUES (#{amenityId}, #{languageCode}, #{name})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM amenity_translations WHERE amenity_id = #{amenityId} AND language_code = #{languageCode}
SELECT id, code, icon_url FROM amenities WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE amenities SET icon_url = #{iconUrl} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.code, a.icon_url, t.name FROM amenities a LEFT JOIN amenity_translations t ON t.amenity_id = a.id AND t.language_code = 'ko' ORDER BY a.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM amenities WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM amenity_translations WHERE amenity_id = #{amenityId} AND language_code = #{languageCode}
mapper.select: SELECT amenity_id, destination_type FROM amenity_destination_types WHERE amenity_id = #{amenityId} ORDER BY destination_type
